steps.action: Place the red round 2x2 brick on the center of the red plate, toward the back between the grey slopes and the front wall.
watch_for: Center it on the red plate, not on the grey grille piece at the left
Press it fully down onto the studs

steps.action: Attach the two grey tall slopes on the left end, one at each back and front corner, with the sloped faces pointing inward toward the center.
watch_for: Slopes must face inward toward the red plate, not outward
Place them on the left end, matching the grey slopes already on the right end
Do not cover the grey grille piece between them
